question: To whom should the arrangement of the two syllables be imparted?
premises: There is an arrangement of two syllables
It should be given among others
inference: The two-syllable arrangement should be imparted to others as prescribed.
uncertainties: The meaning of anyanteṣu is obscure; it may refer to other recipients or other contexts.
plain_english: One should impart the arrangement of the two syllables among others.
